issue.title: Three testcases of test_arpall script fails for multi-asic chassis-packet system

failure.body:
**Description**

test_arpall script fails for multi-asic chassis-packet system

we saw that three testcases passed for asic0 and failed for asic1.

=========================== short test summary info ============================
FAILED arp/test_arpall.py::test_arp_unicast_reply[sfd-t2-lc2-1] - Exception
FAILED arp/test_arpall.py::test_arp_expect_reply[sfd-t2-lc2-1] - Exception
FAILED arp/test_arpall.py::test_arp_garp_no_update[sfd-t2-lc2-1] - Exception
PASSED arp/test_arpall.py::test_arp_unicast_reply[sfd-t2-lc2-0]
PASSED arp/test_arpall.py::test_arp_expect_reply[sfd-t2-lc2-0]
PASSED arp/test_arpall.py::test_arp_no_reply_other_intf[sfd-t2-lc2-0]
PASSED arp/test_arpall.py::test_arp_no_reply_src_out_range[sfd-t2-lc2-0]
PASSED arp/test_arpall.py::test_arp_garp_no_update[sfd-t2-lc2-0]
PASSED arp/test_arpall.py::test_arp_no_reply_other_intf[sfd-t2-lc2-1]
PASSED arp/test_arpall.py::test_arp_no_reply_src_out_range[sfd-t2-lc2-1]
===================== 3 failed, 7 passed in 850.26 seconds =====================

On debugging it, we noticed that the testcases first selects the interfaces and then finds the PTF indices from mg_facts. In case of asic0, the mg_facts has the right PTF indices and it maps correctly to the vars/topo_t2.yaml file. But in case of asic1, it doesn’t map properly and hence the testcase fails. I have highlighted Ethernet0, Ethernet1, Ethernet13 and Ethernet 14. In case of asic0, Ethernet0 and Ethernet1 is selected for the test and in case of asic1, Ethernet13 and Ethernet14 is selected. Not sure why mg_facts is so off for asic1.

ASIC0: --snippet of the output
Mg Fact PTF Indices are { u'Ethernet0': 64, u'Ethernet1': 65, u'Ethernet13': 77, u'Ethernet14': 7}

ASIC1:
Mg Fact PTF Indices are {u'Ethernet0': 48, u'Ethernet1': 49, u'Ethernet13': 61, u'Ethernet14': 62}

resolution.title: [chassis] Changes to get correct PTF Port in Multi-asic and also alias mapping enhancement
resolution.description:
Fixes:
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/issues/4981
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/issues/5071

What i did:

```
  1. Updated library `port_utils.py` to be generic by get port alias data from device. Only Data needed for Connection Graph
      need to be added for each vendor.

   2.  Added Change to get correct PTF Index Port in case of Multi-Asic
      where ports are distiributed randomly across ASIC's

   3. Fix the BGP Peer/Neighbor parsing in namespace context
```

How I verify:

After this change arpall test case is passing fine.
